description: This file defines a REST controller for handling utility payment operations in a Java Spring application. It provides endpoints for reading payments and processing a payment request.

classes.name: UtilityPaymentController
classes.description: A Spring REST controller managing utility payment endpoints, utilizing constructor injection for the service.

methods.name: readPayments
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a paginated list of utility payments.

methods.name: processPayment
methods.description: Handles POST requests to process a new utility payment based on the received request object.
